note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 4.3 ("A BGP speaker SHOULD treat an UPDATE message of this form as though the WITHDRAWN ROUTES do not contain the address prefix."). Positive: TestRIBSamePrefixInWithdrawnAndNLRIInstallsTheRoute (structured path, initial install and repeat without withdrawal flap), TestRIBPoolPathSamePrefixInWithdrawnAndNLRIInstallsTheRoute (JSON/pool path), and TestRIBInjectSamePrefixInWithdrawnAndNLRIInstallsTheRoute (injection path) prove the duplicated prefix ends up installed because rib_structured.go processes withdrawals before announcements. Negative: TestRFC4271MixedUpdateStillAppliesItsOtherWithdrawals proves another prefix listed only in WITHDRAWN ROUTES (11.0.0.0/8) is still removed from Adj-RIB-In and Loc-RIB while the duplicated prefix (10.0.0.0/8) remains installed.
